segments.text:
V. 28.
And all in the ſynagogue were filled with fury—Perceiving the Purport of his Diſcourſe, namely, that the Bleſſing which they deſpiſed, would be offered to and accepted by the Gentiles. So changeable are the Hearts of wicked Men! So little are their Starts of Love to be depended on! So unable are they to bear the clo•• Application, even of a Diſcourſe which they moſt admire!
